primaryOutcome: An ordinary user can turn one real Chinese meeting into a recording they can find, understand, correct, export and reopen without learning engineering controls.

knownProblems.problem: Owner dislikes the green palette. Native inherited dark/blue/green surfaces are inconsistent with the neutral source preview.
knownProblems.action: Use one neutral light/dark token system from the selected reference, consistent buttons, borders, type scale and spacing on actual desktop and phone.

knownProblems.problem: Filters, organisation and AI tools still expose too many choices and unclear effects.
knownProblems.action: Use the selected sidebar/list/document hierarchy. Primary flow is recording, transcript and minutes. Library filters, multi-select and organisation are separate requested panels; explicit action names belong beside their content. Secondary capabilities remain reachable.

knownProblems.problem: Actual019f minutes put unintelligible ASR fragments in meeting questions and repeat filler-heavy source material in the main reading body.
knownProblems.action: Fix the actual generation and reading contract: uncertain material stays attached to source/time for review; do not promote fragments to a meeting question, decision or task. Preserve raw transcript and original generated versions; no manual fake clean success.

knownProblems.problem: Actual Chinese recording quality is not adequate. Existing louder public playback improved early male speech but does not qualify general accuracy.
knownProblems.action: Use the requested approximately30-minute public Chinese human meeting, compare original source and card-captured audio with the same declared model and alignment. Separate playback/capture degradation from ASR errors; reuse prior failed model comparisons, select only on actual evidence.

knownProblems.action: Record this as adapter scope failure, not a product auto-connect failure. Next physical experience must use current normal830 evidence, live board ownership and explicit readiness in the original shared window; no silent capture.
